position: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS): Medicare Regulatory Reforms
proposal: The Mandate recommends that CMS eliminate the Medicare inpatient-only list, expand the ambulatory surgical center covered procedures list, and extend site-neutral payment so that Medicare pays the same for a service whether delivered in a physician office, clinic or hospital outpatient department.

Test (b): nothing is different from or opposite to the ask; the rural sole community hospital exemption narrows but does not reverse it. Test (c): the ask is regulatory and needs no act of Congress. sources.title: CY 2026 Hospital Outpatient Prospective Payment System final rule summary

status_summary: The CY 2026 outpatient payment final rule, published 2025-11-25 and effective 2026-01-01, finalizes a three-year phase-out of the inpatient-only list, with the full list eliminated by 2029-01-01 according to a rule summary, and removes 285 services in the first year; it adds 276 procedures to the ASC covered procedures list plus 271 codes leaving the inpatient-only list, and pays the physician fee schedule equivalent rate for drug administration at excepted off-campus hospital departments, exempting rural sole community hospitals. The CY 2027 proposed rule of 2026-07-07 would remove 637 more services from the list, add 618 ASC codes, and apply the equivalent rate to imaging without contrast at those departments. The stage is implemented because the elimination policy, ASC expansion and site-neutral extension are operative through a final rule, while the list remains in place until the phase-out ends and site-neutral payment so far reaches only selected services.
